title: LUMEN / The city wakes
logline: At dawn, a sleeping processor hears the first signal of a city and transforms isolated sensors into a living network.
beats: A suspended exploded chip descends into alignment. Fine cyan pins and transparent top layer catch reflected light; dust drifts behind the headline. A slow camera arc reveals the layered construction.

Cut from the assembled core to three wide cards: SENSE, DECIDE, RESPOND. Connectors draw left to right, travelling particles continue the signal and an original ECG-like path writes beneath the architecture.
The concept network comes online over a subtle synthetic moving plate. A reflective knot sits inside a glass orbital ring. A 0-100% illustrative counter and four-bar progression resolve, then hold.
direction: Premium technical editorial: midnight navy, ice-blue machined layers, restrained mint signal accents. Use spacious Swiss-style typography, thin schematic lines and reflected hero geometry; no cluttered dashboard wallpaper.
physics: Use standard hard-surface boxes, a transparent glass top plate, reflective liquid-metal knot, torus glass refraction, soft procedural environment light and a single ground mirror. Keep shader amplitude subtle so the structure remains legible.
checklist: Actual Material memory icon and Lucide cpu/radio/brain-circuit/zap glyphs.
Root linked connectors with six travelling particles, editable wave path.
Grouped caption card, text, rounded rectangles, circle particles, embedded video, counter and chart.
Physical glass/metal, procedural geometry, object tracks, camera tracks and planar mirror.

title: AER / The valley that remembers
logline: A paper bird follows the first light across a quiet valley and discovers an observatory floating above a luminous lake.
beats: Establish three layered mountain silhouettes, a pale sun and distant bird marks. The far ridge shifts 20px while the closer ridge shifts 30px oppositely: depth comes from measured parallax, not a random zoom. The title occupies sky, not the mountains.

A warmer sun settles above the lake. A small original paper-bird path travels on a curved route; a fine golden trail writes behind it. Low-opacity seeded gas creates mist while a separate water viewport ripples across the lower composition.

The camera reveals a cream circular platform, teal glass dome, gold orbital ring and beacon. Stars drift behind; glass and a horizontal mirror catch light. A left-aligned two-line statement resolves beside the artifact.
direction: Poetic illustrated travel film. Deep teal atmosphere, warm paper-gold sunrise, mint lake light. Prioritize a layered graphic landscape over photorealism. Keep mountain silhouettes clean; do not put text over busy wave detail.
physics: Lake waves are deterministic vertex deformation on a horizontal water plane. Mist is a low-opacity seeded shader proxy, not volumetric simulation. The observatory uses cylinder/sphere/torus/cone geometry, glass transmission and one mirror pass; the bird follows authored keyframes rather than aerodynamics.
checklist: Original landscape SVG paths with near/far parallax.
Circle sun, drifting firefly particles, authored paper-bird path and curved trail.
Standalone gas atmosphere and shared-scene water material.
Multi-part procedural observatory, glass dome, camera approach and mirror.

title: THE LITTLE TABLE / Golden-hour skillet
logline: Mira returns from an imagined evening market with one small basket and turns it into a warm tomato-chickpea skillet for a friend.
beats: Introduce the basket ingredients as glossy but illustrated procedural produce. Three staggered recipe cards establish cooked chickpeas, tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, lemon and herbs; state 2 servings without inventing health claims.

A stylized cream bowl/pan assembles from flattened sphere and torus geometry. Tomato/chickpea pieces descend on authored easeOut trajectories; herb shapes settle on top. Warm seeded steam lifts above, without obscuring recipe steps.

Present the completed dish with a slower overhead camera angle. A restrained warm halo frames the plate. The left column reveals finish instructions: lemon, herbs, share while warm. An original supplied image mark closes the editorial recipe.
direction: Warm cookbook editorial. Cocoa background, terracotta-red produce, golden oil, pale ceramic, sage herbs. Macro-inspired framing with ample space, tactile shadows and one readable action per recipe card; never render fake food photography.
physics: Food geometry is a deliberately stylized composition of spheres, a torus rim, cone stem and cylinder tool. Ingredient drops are keyframed, not collision simulation. Steam uses the gas shader. Physical lighting and ceramic roughness create depth; no actual heat transfer or cooking simulation is implied.
checklist: Grouped ingredient and process cards with real Lucide salad/cooking-pot/leaf/flame/timer glyphs.
Procedural ingredients, shallow bowl, rim, garnish and staged falling motion.
Gas steam with fixed seed, cast shadows and warm environment reflections.
Editable recipe typography, halo circle and original supplied PNG seal.

title: ROOM 04 / One clear decision
logline: Four fictional teammates enter a meeting with separate ideas and leave with one visible decision, an owner and a next step.
beats: Reveal four abstract head-and-body figures around a transparent table. Differently coloured teammates share a camera frame, not separate fake video-call feeds. Left cards give each discipline a concrete question.

Replace the meeting room with a three-part decision map: question, constraint, decision. Step connectors draw first, cards appear in order and travelling dots imply thought moving toward action. Preserve legible long-form labels in 80px-safe framing.

A glass decision tile and a reflective ring become a quiet emblem of alignment. Three final cards state the decision, owner and learning goal. Stop the camera at 4.5s and hold the final hand-off through 6s.
direction: Refined strategy presentation, not a busy SaaS dashboard. Ink-violet space, lavender emphasis, mint completion. Use consistent card sizes, large readable editorial titles and a thin shared progress rail.
physics: Abstract people use sphere/cylinder primitives. The table and final decision tile use transmission glass; the closing ring uses restrained liquidMetal reflection and a single mirror. All spatial motion is keyframed. No emotion recognition, real attendee analysis or real meeting recording is implied.
checklist: Eight-part procedural team plus glass table with shared 3D lighting.
Groups, text and rectangular decision cards; root step connectors and travelling particles.
Real Lucide team/question/controls/check/owner/target symbols.
Glass tile, reflective ring, camera orbit, cast shadows and mirror.

title: THE LONG TABLE / A small kindness travels
logline: A handwritten invitation in an imaginary neighborhood travels from one doorway to the next until strangers build a shared evening table.
beats: Show a warmly lit note floating over a geometric neighborhood silhouette. The paper rotates slowly into place, with a large dark invitation headline. Keep the handwritten-story feeling without requiring external fonts.

The invitation moves into a wide social graph of four contrasting circular nodes. Draw connections in three phases; each node carries a real local symbol for care, conversation, growth or home. Use measured travelling particles and meaningful labels.

Reveal a stylized shared table and six abstract neighbors arriving at staggered times. A small refractive lantern marks the centre, warm particles suggest evening, and the final line holds: There is room for one more.
direction: Warm community editorial. Forest-green ink, cream paper, honey-gold light and fresh mint. Use human-scale objects, gentle easing and generous breathing room; no fake platform metrics, notification spam or political advocacy.
physics: Paper movement and seating arrivals are authored transforms, not rigid-body simulation. A shared 3D scene supplies physical light, a glass lantern and cast shadows. Connection dots and warm motes are deterministic visual metaphors, not a real social-network simulation.
checklist: Original vector skyline, rotating invitation card and oversized editable text.
Circle nodes, Lucide heart-handshake/message-circle/sprout/house glyphs and linked Bezier paths.
Multi-part 3D table/people/lantern, group cards and warm particle atmosphere.
Fiction labels and a final hold preserve narrative clarity without fabricated impact claims.
